retirement_basis: Reviewed programs without references from current checked-in application/runtime, automated test/workflow entrypoints, package commands or declared maintained manual tools. Historical-only dependencies are retained in the archives across all three repositories.
reproduction: Use source_revision and original_path in isolated checkouts of the repositories for historical execution. Programs are preserved byte-for-byte and retain their original relative-root and sibling-repository assumptions; this archive is not a current command entrypoint.
preserved: Original source bytes and executable modes
Existing protocols, measurements, reports, literature, data and evidence manifests
Current automated tests, runtime code, package commands and supported manual tooling
Explicitly retained CDN protocols and local runtime/credential directories
